stem: Last week you added the booking site's domain under Configure your domains in the web stream's tag settings. Today the marketing lead reports that outbound clicks from the main site to the booking site fell to almost zero, while bookings held steady, and asks whether tracking broke. What do you tell them?

options.text: Tracking broke: listing a domain there switches off enhanced measurement for the stream
Nothing broke: links to a domain on that list no longer fire outbound click events
Tracking broke: the booking domain must also be listed as an unwanted referral first
Nothing broke: those clicks are now held back by data thresholds until volumes grow
